source: PC thermometer: the level's angrytime=180 in the PC data (level_suntan/level.xml, 1/20 s ticks) is the 9.0 s the mercury takes to drain from full — tools/pcref/thermo.py measured the same off the video; PCThermometerDrain 11.11 %/s is the HUD's drawing rate only, the tick meter keeps the mobile data's AngryMeterDecay (docs/PC_FIDELITY.md §7). PC per-trick angrytime (tricks.xml: groundbanana 300 (every room); 1/20 s): the anger indicator holds at its maximum that long after the trick — the thermometer's long holds on the video (E14's marbles 18.1 s, E09's 12.6, E05's 14.6) — carried as PCAngryTime for the profile's hold (docs/PC_FIDELITY.md §7).
